topics.title: Vector length, normalization, unit vectors, dot products, angles between vectors

Orthogonal and orthonormal sets/bases, Gram-Schmidt orthonormalization process
Least Squares problem, deriving projections onto sub-dimensional workspaces

topics.title: Coordinate rotations in $R^2$ and projections in $R^3$

Control Statements: Conditional branching (if-else, switch), loop mechanisms (while, do-while, for), break, continue

topics.title: One-Dimensional Arrays: Declaration, memory allocation, structural initialization, index access
Search & Sort: Sequential Search, Bubble Sort sorting algorithm
Matrix Processing: Two-dimensional arrays, row/column iterations, matrix operations
Custom Types: User-defined types via typedef, Enumerated (enum) data types

topics.title: Modularization: Function definitions, prototypes, local vs global variables, scope
Parameter Passing: Pass-by-Value vs Pass-by-Reference, array data transfers into functions
Recursion: Coding recursive processes, memory overhead handling
Strings: String arrays, processing actions without built-in library overrides

modules.title: Module 4: Pointers, Memory Control, and Data Files

topics.title: Pointers: Declarations, reference (&) and dereference (*) operations, pointer arithmetic
Advanced Pointers: Pointer-to-pointer, arrays of pointers, tracking array layouts via offsets
Dynamic Memory Allocation: Runtime allocation via malloc/calloc
File Management: Core file types, code syntax for opening, processing, modifying, and closing files
